Ultimately, we will be providing them with (a) a cohort-style experience with other adult learners, (b) flexibility to craft a learning experience that capitalizes on their professional growth, and (c) courses that offer knowledge-acquisition and skills-development that resonate with the needs of professional workplaces. In summation, the Professional Leadership Studies program changes include: • SPC 211 (Professional Communication) o A new course designed to enhance the professional writing and communication of our Professional Studies students. • SPC 221 (Finance and Budgeting for Professional Workplaces) o A shift in course number a title to entice students from across Professional Studies to take it earlier in their academic journey.
